# Resonite MCP — Full Tool Reference (SOTA 2026)

**FastMCP 3.2+ | Python 3.12+ | Ports 10978/10979**

## Server Identity

- **Name:** Resonite MCP
- **Version:** 0.8.0
- **Role:** Natural language control of the Resonite social VR platform
- **Repo:** https://github.com/sandraschi/resonite-mcp

## Architecture

```
                          ┌──────────────────────┐
                          │   Claude / Cursor     │
                          └──────────┬───────────┘
                                     │ MCP (stdio/HTTP)
                          ┌──────────▼───────────┐
                          │  resonite-mcp server  │
                          │  (FastMCP 3.2+ ASPI) │  port 10979
                          └───┬───────┬──────┬───┘
                              │       │      │
                    ┌─────────▼──┐ ┌──▼───┐ ┌▼──────────┐
                    │ OSC (UDP) │ │REST  │ │ResoniteLink│
                    │ port 9000  │ │HTTPS │ │WS port 4242│
                    └────────────┘ └──────┘ └────────────┘
```

**Layers:**
| Layer | Technology | Port | Purpose |
|-------|-----------|------|---------|
| Frontend | Vite + React 19 + Tailwind | 10978 | Web SPA dashboard |
| Backend | FastAPI + FastMCP 3.2 | 10979 | REST API + MCP transport |
| OSC | python-osc (UDP) | 9000 | Real-time Resonite control |
| ResoniteLink | WebSocket JSON | 4242 | Slot/component manipulation |
| Cloud API | HTTPS | 443 | api.resonite.com REST |

## All Registered Tools (~55 tools)

### OSC Communication (8 tools)
- `send_osc(host, port, address, values)` — Send OSC message
- `start_osc_server(port)` — Start OSC listener
- `stop_osc_server(port)` — Stop OSC listener
- `get_received_messages(port)` — Get buffered OSC messages
- `get_latest_message(port)` — Get most recent OSC message
- `get_osc_server_stats(port)` — OSC server stats
- `clear_osc_message_buffer(port)` — Clear buffer
- `test_osc_echo(port)` — Echo test

### Session Management (4 tools)
- `resonite_session_start(session_name, world_path, avatar_slot)` — Start session
- `resonite_session_status()` — Session status
- `resonite_world_load(world_path)` — Load world
- `resonite_session_end()` — End session + cleanup

### Avatar Control (3 tools)
- `resonite_avatar_load(avatar_id, slot, parameters)` — Load avatar
- `resonite_parameter_set(name, value)` — Set avatar parameter
- `resonite_protoflux_execute(script_name, script_data, execute)` — Run ProtoFlux script

### Inventory Management (7 tools)
- `resonite_inventory_list(item_type, search_query, limit, offset)` — List inventory
- `resonite_inventory_search(query, item_type)` — Search inventory
- `resonite_inventory_spawn(item_id, position, rotation, scale)` — Spawn item
- `resonite_inventory_upload(item_path, item_name, item_type, ...)` — Upload item
- `resonite_inventory_delete(item_id, confirm_deletion)` — Delete item
- `resonite_inventory_share(item_id, share_with, permission_level)` — Share item
- `resonite_inventory_info(item_id)` — Item details

### Plugin Management (6 tools)
- `plugin_list()` — List plugins
- `plugin_load(name)` — Load plugin
- `plugin_unload(name)` — Unload plugin
- `plugin_reload(name)` — Reload plugin
- `plugin_discover()` — Discover plugins
- `plugin_info(name)` — Plugin details

### REST API / Cloud (6 tools)
- `resonite_rest_login(username, password, remember_me)` — Login to cloud API
- `resonite_rest_get_sessions(name, host_name, host_id, min_active_users, ...)` — List public sessions
- `resonite_rest_get_user(username_or_id)` — Get user profile
- `resonite_rest_get_records(user_id, path, record_id)` — Browse inventory records
- `resonite_rest_send_message(target_user_id, message)` — Send chat message
- `resonite_rest_get_platform()` — Get platform info

### ResoniteLink Tools (10 tools)
- `resonite_link_connect(host, port)` — Connect WebSocket
- `resonite_link_spawn(template_url, position)` — Spawn object via template URL
- `resonite_link_set(component_id, field, value)` — Set component field value
- `resonite_link_get(component_id, field)` — Get component field value
- `resonite_link_read_field(ref_id)` — Read field by ref ID
- `resonite_link_write_field(ref_id, value, value_type)` — Write field by ref ID
- `resonite_link_get_node(ref_id)` — Get slot/component info by ref ID
- `resonite_link_get_children(slot_id)` — List direct children of slot
- `resonite_link_add_slot(parent_id, name)` — Create child slot
- `resonite_link_add_component(slot_id, component_type)` — Add component to slot
- `resonite_link_destroy_slot(slot_id, preserve_assets)` — Destroy slot
- `resonite_link_reflect(component_type)` — Discover component types/fields
- `resonite_link_batch(operations)` — Execute batch operations atomically

### Cloud Variables (4 tools)
- `resonite_cloud_var_list(user_id)` — List cloud variable definitions
- `resonite_cloud_var_get(path)` — Get cloud variable value
- `resonite_cloud_var_set(path, value)` — Set cloud variable value
- `resonite_cloud_var_delete(path)` — Delete cloud variable

### Friends & Contacts (3 tools)
- `resonite_friends_list()` — List friends
- `resonite_friend_requests()` — List pending friend requests
- `resonite_friend_presence(user_id)` — Get friend presence info

### vBot Robotics (4 tools)
- `resonite_vbot_spawn(robot_type, robot_id, position, scale)` — Spawn vBot
- `resonite_vbot_move(robot_id, linear, angular)` — Move vBot
- `resonite_vbot_head(robot_id, yaw_deg, pitch_deg)` — Move vBot head
- `resonite_vbot_stop(robot_id)` — Stop vBot
- `resonite_vbot_list_types()` — List available vBot types

### Fleet Integration (1 portmanteau, 20 operations)
- `resonite_fleet(operation, ...)` — Cross-fleet asset pipeline
  Operations: list_presets, execution_mode, list_staging, import_staged_assets,
  pull_inkscape_ui, import_blender_asset, import_gimp_texture, list_vrm_staging,
  import_vrm_batch, pull_blender_vrm, pull_avatar_vrm, list_protoflux_presets,
  list_marble_staging, import_worldlabs_batch, pull_inkscape_fab, run_marble_pipeline,
  inventory_status, run_fleet_pipeline, run_strict_fleet_pipeline

### Voice Tools (1 portmanteau)
- `resonite_voice(operation, ...)` — Voice command macros
  Operations: parse_command, execute_command, list_macros, run_macro

### System (4 tools)
- `help(level, topic)` — Documentation
- `status(level, focus)` — Server status
- `health_check()` — Component health
- `search_guides(query, limit)` — Semantic RAG search
- `ask_resonite(question)` — LLM-synthesized answers
- `agentic_plan_execute(goal)` — Autonomous multi-step planning
- `resonite_dashboard_card()` — Prefab status card (App)
- `resonite_inventory_card(limit)` — Prefab inventory card (App)

### Integrations (3 tools)
- `resonite_import_worldlabs_url(world_id, ...)` — Import WorldLabs asset
- `resonite_import_worldlabs_batch(entries, ...)` — Batch import
- `resonite_import_blender(object_name)` — Import from Blender

## Key Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `MCP_PORT` | 10979 | Backend bind port |
| `MCP_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Backend bind host |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | stdio | Transport mode (stdio/http/sse) |
| `RESONITE_OSC_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | OSC target host |
| `RESONITE_OSC_PORT` | 9000 | OSC target port |
| `RESONITE_TOKEN` | — | Cloud API auth token |
| `RESONITE_USER_ID` | — | Cloud API user ID |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` | — | Fleet MCP bridge URLs |
| `RESONITE_TAURI` | 0 | Tauri embedded mode flag |

## Quick Start

```bash
uv sync
uv run python -m resonite_mcp --port 10979
# Frontend: ./web_sota/start.ps1 → http://localhost:10978
```

## Fleet Integration

- Ports: 10978/10979 (fleet range 10700-11500)
- Tauri NSIS: `native/` wrapper with embedded PyInstaller backend
- Cross-MCP: MCPBridge (ProxyProvider) for fleet server federation
- Prefab UI: status/inventory cards for Claude chat rendering

## Testing

```bash
uv run pytest tests/unit/
just e2e   # Playwright E2E smoke test
just cua-nsis-test  # CUA NSIS install→launch→verify→uninstall
```

## Standards Compliance

- FastMCP 3.2+ with ctx.sample(), portmanteau pattern, Prefab UI
- Fleet port range 10700-11500 (10978/10979)
- Dual transport: stdio (Claude Desktop) + HTTP (Tauri)
- Playwright E2E + CUA NSIS smoke test
- MCPB packaging (`.mcpb` bundles)
- Ruff (Python) + Biome (TypeScript) linting
